CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 37
   C. 13
   D. 36

2. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 4

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 49
   C. 43
   D. 41

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

6. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 65
   C. 64
   D. 0

7. Solve for x: x + 9 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 6
   C. 9
   D. 7

8. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 20
   D. 1

9. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 10

10. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 3
   C. 28
   D. 11

11. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

12. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

13. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 81

15. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 48
   C. 2
   D. 49

16. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 13

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
